summary: Phase 2A Step 2B - Banner Calculator Integration full frontend test. All 15 specified features tested and passing. Banner materials loaded from DB (not hardcoded), Quick Templates work correctly, Add-ons section fully functional with automatic Pole Pockets injection, Final Price includes add-ons total, Banner Wizard opens from Pricing Foundation.
critical_code_review_comments: The applyBannerTemplate function uses m.name.toLowerCase().includes('18 oz') as fallback - this is acceptable per agent context note
The 'banners-add-addon-select' uses Radix UI Select (not native HTML select) - select_option does not work on it; use click + role='option' selector instead (documented)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All banner calculator features from Phase 2A Step 2B are working. Material dropdown shows DB materials (13 oz Banner, 18 oz Banner, Mesh Banner, Blockout Banner, Pole Banner Material, etc.). Templates, add-ons, final price calculation all verified. Banner Wizard (BannerSetupWizard.js) accessible via Setup button in Pricing Foundation > Category Methods > Banners card. The Banners card Setup button is at x≈430, y≈723 on a 1920x1080 viewport when scrolled to Category Methods section.
